title: 開いた状態の壁掛けおむつ交換台
description: 公共施設のトイレを演出する、開いた状態で固定した壁掛けおむつ交換台。浅い成形トレー、壁面ケース、蝶番、下面の支持材と補強リブ、静止ベルトを備えます。壁や乳児は含みません。折り畳み動作や耐荷重・拘束・衛生機能はなく、乳幼児用製品としての安全認証もありません。実用品の設計や安全な使用方法を示すものではありません。壁面位置と設置高さは利用先で調整してください。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.900 × 0.630 × 0.718 m、15,740三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A decorative wall-mounted baby-changing station held in its open pose for public washroom scenes. Includes a recessed molded tray, wall enclosure, hinge barrels, underside braces and ribs, and a static belt. No wall or child is included. There is no folding behavior, rated support, restraint or hygiene function and no child-use safety certification. It is not a physical product design or safe-use guidance. Adjust wall offset and installation height in the target scene. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.900 × 0.630 × 0.718 m; 15,740 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
